Correctness checks

Try altered proofs and challenges, or verify the bundled public Python reference fixture. At very low repetition counts, a tampered proof may pass by chance; these checks report observations, not a security guarantee.

What does the UI measurement mean?

Animation frame gaps show how regularly this page can update while its worker computes. They are not touch latency measurements or a security test. Background tabs pause animation callbacks, so hidden intervals are flagged in the report.

No measurements yet.

Reports contain timings, public fingerprints, check results, browser metadata, and your notes. They exclude private keys, raw proof bytes, and challenge nonces.

Quick guideRead
  1. Run a round trip. The default profile matches the full Python parity test and uses compact proofs. Proof repetitions change proof size independently of circuit rounds. The worker generates the secret, creates a proof, then verifies it using only the public context.
  2. Check failure handling. Run tamper checks and the independent Python reference check. Cancel a long run to terminate the worker immediately.
  3. Measure your device. Run the benchmark with this tab visible, add device notes, and download the report. Scroll and use the page while the worker runs.
  4. Cross-check two devices. Export both public files, import them on the other device, and select Verify proof. Optical transfer and session replay handling belong to the later app integration.
